Rashi on Ketubot 16b:10:1.hebrew: ראויה היתה זו לאכול בתרומה - אי נישאת לכהן, דבתולה שלמה נמצאת ולא בעולה שתפסל לכהן מחמת זנות:
Rashi on Ketubot 16b:10:1.english: This [woman] would have been fit to eat teruma - if she had married a priest, for she was found [to be] a complete virgin and not a non-virgin who would be disqualified to a priest on account of illicit intercourse.

Rashi on Ketubot 16b:10:2.english: Rav Pappa objects to it - And how is this proof that [she was] not [previously] married [as] a widow?

Rashi on Ketubot 16b:10:3.hebrew: אטו - אי נישאת כשהיא אלמנה לכהן הדיוט, מי לא אכלה בתרומה:
Rashi on Ketubot 16b:10:3.english: Is that to say - If she married an ordinary priest while she was a widow, does she not eat terumah?

Rashi on Ketubot 16b:10:4.english: This [bride] is first - Her intercourse is first.

Rashi on Ketubot 16b:11:1.hebrew: זימנין דתפסה מאתים - בלא בית דין, וכי בעינן לאפוקי מינה משום דאין עדים שהעבירו לפניה, אמרה: איתנוסי הוא דאיתניסו, שיכורים היו מאונס יין המשתה. הלכך, השתא אתו עדים שהעבירו לפניה פתוחה, ותו ליכא מידי:
Rashi on Ketubot 16b:11:1.english: At times she seizes two hundred [zuz] - Without [authorization of] the court. And when we seek to exact [it] from her because there are no witnesses that they passed [a sealed barrel] before her, she says: "They were prevented by unavoidable circumstances; they were drunk from the compulsion of the wine of the feast." Therefore, now witnesses come [and testify] that they passed an open [barrel] before her, and there is nothing further [she can claim].

Rashi on Ketubot 16b:12:1.english: How does one dance - What does one say before her.

Rashi on Ketubot 16b:1:1.english: And this [woman], since she has no publicity - For there is no one testifying about her that she went out in a hinuma [bridal veil].

Rashi on Ketubot 16b:2:1.hebrew: כי אתו עדים מאי הוי - כיון דחזקה דיש לה קול, הרבה היו יודעין:
Rashi on Ketubot 16b:2:1.english: When witnesses come, what of it - Since it is a presumption that she has publicity, many [people] would have known.

Rashi on Ketubot 16b:3:1.english: Perhaps she will produce witnesses - [That is,] witnesses of the hinnuma.

Rashi on Ketubot 16b:3:2.english: This indicates - And [this is] not in accordance with the one who says, "One does not write [a receipt]," in Bava Batra.

Rashi on Ketubot 16b:3:3.hebrew: כותבין שובר - שכשיפרע לה כתובתה, תכתוב לו שקבלה כתובתה, ויהיה בידו לזכות:
Rashi on Ketubot 16b:3:3.english: One writes a receipt - That when he pays her her marriage contract, she writes for him that she has received her marriage contract, and it will be in his possession as proof [of his right].

Rashi on Ketubot 16b:3:4.hebrew: רב פפא אמר - לעולם אין כותבין, דנמצא זה צריך לשמור שוברו מן העכברים, ומי שיש לו שטר על חברו, או יביא השטר ויחזירנו או לא יטול כלום. ומתני', במקום שאין כותבין כתובה, אלא סומכין על תנאי בית דין שתקנו לבתולה מאתים ולאלמנה מנה, דליכא למיחש לדלמא הדרה ומפקא לה:
Rashi on Ketubot 16b:3:4.english: Rav Pappa said - In fact, one never writes [a receipt], for [otherwise] this [husband] would end up having to guard his receipt from mice; rather, whoever holds a document against his fellow either brings the document and returns it, or takes nothing. And [our] Mishnah [is dealing] with a place where they do not write a ketubah, but rather rely on the stipulation of the court — that they enacted two hundred [dinars] for a virgin and a maneh for a widow — so that there is no concern that perhaps she will go back and produce it.

Rashi on Ketubot 16b:4:1.english: Who teach it - [that] of Rabbi Abbahu and of Rav Pappa.

Rashi on Ketubot 16b:4:2.hebrew: הטמינה כתובתה - והיא תובעת מאתים, והוא אומר: אלמנה נשאתיך:
Rashi on Ketubot 16b:4:2.english: She concealed her marriage contract - And she claims two hundred [dinars], and he says, "I married you [as] a widow."

Rashi on Ketubot 16b:4:3.english: Danced before her - If there are witnesses that [people] danced before her on the day of her wedding.

Rashi on Ketubot 16b:4:4.hebrew: כוס של בשורה - המבשר עליה סימני בתולות, ולקמן מפרש מאי היא:
Rashi on Ketubot 16b:4:4.english: A cup of tidings - Which announces regarding her signs of virginity, and later [the Gemara] explains what it is.

Rashi on Ketubot 16b:7:1.hebrew: אלא - הכי קאמר: כל איבדה כמי שהטמינה בפנינו דמי, ולא גביא. והכי קתני: "איבדה כתובתה, הטמינה כתובתה, נשרפה כתובתה, אם רקדו לפניה וכו'". והכי פירושה: אמרה "אבד שטר כתובתה" — הרי היא כמו שהטמינה כתובתה בפנינו כדי להוציא ולגבות פעם שניה, ואינה גובה כלום אא"כ תביא השטר; ואם אמרה "נשרפה" ויש עדים שנשרפה, דהשתא ליכא למיחש למידי, תביא עדים שרקדו לפניה, שזהו סימן לבתולה, ותגבה מאתים:
Rashi on Ketubot 16b:7:1.english: Rather - This is what [the Gemara] is saying: Any [case where] she lost [her marriage contract] is like one where she concealed [it] before us, and she does not collect. And this is what [the baraita] teaches: "[If] she lost her marriage contract, concealed her marriage contract, [or] her marriage contract was burned, if they danced before her, etc." And this is its explanation: [If] she said, "Her marriage contract document was lost," she is like one who concealed her marriage contract before us in order to produce [it] and collect a second time, and she collects nothing unless she brings the document. But if she said, "It was burned," and there are witnesses that it was burned — so that now there is nothing to be concerned about — she brings witnesses that they danced before her, which is a sign of a virgin, and she collects two hundred [zuz].

Rashi on Ketubot 16b:8:1.english: The one who teaches it - [The dispute] of Rabbi Abbahu and Rav Pappa, with regard to the baraita.

Rashi on Ketubot 16b:8:2.hebrew: כל שכן אמתניתין - דכיון דאברייתא, דקתני בהדיא איבדה כתובתה גביא, ועלה קאמר רב פפא דלא גביא, ומתרץ לה דחדא קתני: איבדה כתובת' הרי היא כמו שהטמינה, וכשנשרפה הוא דקא גביא, ולעולם אין כותבין שובר — כל שכן דאמתני' איכא למיתני פלוגתא דרב פפא אדר' אבהו, למימר דבמקום שאין כותבין כתובה עסקי':
Rashi on Ketubot 16b:8:2.english: All the more so [with regard] to the Mishnah - For since [with regard] to the baraita, which teaches explicitly [that if] she lost her ketubah she collects, and regarding it Rav Pappa says that she does not collect, and he resolves it [by saying] that it teaches one [case] — [namely, that if] she lost her ketubah, it is as though she hid it, and it is [only] when it was burned that she collects, and in fact we do not write a receipt — all the more so [with regard] to the Mishnah can one teach the dispute of Rav Pappa against Rabbi Abbahu, saying that we are dealing with a place where they do not write a ketubah.

Rashi on Ketubot 16b:8:3.hebrew: ומאן דמתני - פלוגתא דרב פפא ודר' אבהו אמתני':
Rashi on Ketubot 16b:8:3.english: And the one who teaches - [This refers to] the dispute of Rav Pappa and Rabbi Abbahu with regard to the Mishnah.

Rashi on Ketubot 16b:8:4.hebrew: אבל אברייתא לא - מתני ליה, דודאי שמעינן מינה דכותבין שובר, דהא במקום שכותבין כתובה עסקינן:
Rashi on Ketubot 16b:8:4.english: However, with regard to the baraita, [he does] not - teach it, for we certainly learn from it that we write a receipt, since we are dealing with a place where they write a marriage contract.

Rashi on Ketubot 16b:8:5.hebrew: כי קושיין - דקתני איבדה כתובתה, ולא ניחא לשנויי שינויא דחיקא למימר איבדה כתובת' כהטמינה כתובתה קאמר:
Rashi on Ketubot 16b:8:5.english: In accordance with our difficulty - For [the baraita] teaches, "she forfeited her ketubah," and it is not satisfactory to give a forced answer to say [that] "she forfeited her ketubah" means "she hid her ketubah."

Rashi on Ketubot 16b:9:1.hebrew: כיון דלא אפשר - כגון במקום שאין כותבין כתובה וגובות על פי עדים, ויש לחוש לשמא תלך לב"ד אחר ותביא עדים אחרים ותגבה פעם שניה — ודאי כתבינן שובר:
Rashi on Ketubot 16b:9:1.english: Since it is not possible - For example, in a place where they do not write a ketubah and [women] collect on the basis of witnesses, and there is concern lest she go to another court, bring other witnesses, and collect a second time — we certainly write a receipt.

Tosafot on Ketubot 16b:11:1.hebrew: איתנוסי הוא דאיתניסו - נראה דמיירי כגון דאיכא מגו, דאי בעיא אמרה: "אין בידי כלום", דאי לאו הכי אמאי מהימנא? ואם תאמר: בחילוק קליות, דאמר לקמן: "ארמלתא לית לה כסני", אמאי לא חיישינן דלמא תפסה כו', כדאמר הכא? ואומר רבינו תם, דדוקא בדבר שיש טורח — כגון חבית דהכא — יכולה לומר דאיתניסו, אבל קליות ושאר דברים שהן קלים לעשות — לא:
Tosafot on Ketubot 16b:11:1.english: "It was due to circumstances beyond their control" - It appears that [the Gemara] is speaking of a case where there is a miggo, for if she wanted, she could say: "There is nothing in my possession," for if not for this, why would she be believed? And if you ask: Regarding the distribution of parched grain, [concerning] which [the Gemara] says later, "A widow does not have parched grain [distributed for her]," why are we not concerned that perhaps she will seize [two hundred dinars], etc., as [the Gemara] says here? Rabbeinu Tam says that specifically regarding something that involves effort — such as the barrel here — she can say that circumstances prevented them [from doing so], but [regarding] parched grain and other things that are easy to do — [she] cannot.

Tosafot on Ketubot 16b:1:1.hebrew: וזו הואיל ואין לה קול איתרע לה רובא - תימה, דתנן בפירקין (לקמן כתובות כח.): "אלו נאמנים להעיד בגודלן מה שראו בקטנותן: זכורני בפלונית שיצאה בהינומא וראשה פרוע", וקאמר בגמ': מ"ט? כיון דרוב נשים בתולות נישאות, גילוי מילתא בעלמא הוא. והשתא, היכי מיירי? אם יש לה קול, למה צריך שום עדות? לרב, ניזיל בתר רובא, כדפריך הכא! ואי אין לה קול, א"כ איתרע לה רובא, ויצטרך שני עדים כשרים! וכי תימא דכשמעיד הוא שראה בקוטנו ואחר עמו חשבינן קול — הא פריך הכא: "סהדי שקרי נינהו"! ויש לומר, דרוב נשים בתולות נישאות עדיף מ"רוב נשים הנישאות בתולות יש לה קול", וכי אין לה קול לא יתרע כל כך רוב דבתולות נישאות, שלא יועיל עדות דראה בקוטנו ואחר עמו:
Tosafot on Ketubot 16b:1:1.english: And this [woman], because she has no publicity, the [effect of the] majority is undermined - This is puzzling, for we learned in a Mishnah in our chapter (below, Ketubot 28a): "These are believed to testify in their adulthood [regarding] what they saw in their childhood: [one is believed to say,] 'I remember about so-and-so that she went out in a bridal veil (hinuma) and with her head uncovered,'" and the Gemara asks: What is the reason? Since most women marry as virgins, [his testimony] is merely a revelation of the matter [that was already likely]. Now, what case are we dealing with? If she has publicity [of her marriage], why is any testimony needed at all? According to Rav, let us follow the majority, as [the Gemara] asks here! And if she does not have publicity, then the [presumption of the] majority is undermined, and two valid witnesses will be required! And if you should say that when he testifies [about] what he saw in his childhood and another [person] is with him, we consider [that] publicity — behold, [the Gemara] asks here: "[Are] they false witnesses?!" And one can answer that [the principle that] "most women marry as virgins" is stronger than [the principle that] "most women who marry as virgins have publicity," so when she has no publicity, the majority [presumption] that [women] marry as virgins is not undermined to such an extent that testimony of what one saw in his childhood with another [person] with him would be ineffective.

Tosafot on Ketubot 16b:3:1.hebrew: וליחוש דלמא מפקא כו' - ואפי' ע"י עדי הינומא לא היה לה לגבות עד שתחזיר לו הכתובה, כיון שיכול לבא לידי הפסד במה שנשארה כתובה תחת ידה. דלא מיבעיא למ"ד דיכול לטעון אחר מעשה ב"ד דמפסיד, דאם לא יהיה לה כתובה יהי' נאמן לומר "פרעתי", אלא אפילו למ"ד דלא מצי טעין אחר מעשה בית דין, מפסיד במה שהכתובה תחת ידה: שאם תתבענו פעם אחרת ולא יהיו לה עדי הינומא, יהא נאמן לומר "פרעתי מנה" במגו דאי בעי אמר "אלמנה נשאתיך", או אם יהא במקום שאין מכירין אם היא אשתו, יהיה נאמן לומר "פרעתי הכל" במגו דאי בעי אמר "אין את אשתי"; והשתא שהכתובה בידה תוציא מאתים, וכיון שיכול לבא לידי הפסד, אין לו לפרוע:
Tosafot on Ketubot 16b:3:1.english: And let us be concerned that she might produce, etc. - And even through witnesses of the hinnuma, she should not [be able to] collect until she returns the ketubah to him, since he can come to a loss through the fact that the ketubah remained in her possession. For needless to say, according to the one who says that [a husband] can claim [payment] against a court enactment [ma'aseh beit din], he loses, because if she did not have a ketubah he would be believed to say, "I paid"; rather, even according to the one who says that he cannot claim [payment] against a court enactment, he [still] loses by the ketubah being in her possession: for if she sues him another time and does not have witnesses of the hinnuma, he would be believed to say, "I paid a maneh," with a migo [an argument of credibility] that if he wanted he could have said, "I married you as a widow"; or, if he is in a place where they do not recognize whether she is his wife, he would be believed to say, "I paid everything," with a migo that if he wanted he could have said, "You are not my wife." Whereas now that the ketubah is in her hand, she will extract two hundred [zuz]; and since he can come to a loss, he does not have to pay.

Tosafot on Ketubot 16b:3:2.hebrew: זאת אומרת כותבין שובר - אע"ג דהכא לא אפשר, דאיכא למיחש דלמא תשרוף כתובתה בעדים והדרא וגביא בעדי הינומא, כדאמרינן בסמוך: "ודלמא הדרא ומפקא בעדי הינומא וגביא", למ"ד "הטוען אחר מעשה בית דין לא אמר כלום", וע"כ זקוק הוא לשובר; מ"מ דייק שפיר דבעלמא נמי כותבין שובר, דאי אין כותבין בעלמא — למה יפרע כאן, כיון שיכול לבא לידי הפסד במה שהכתובה בידה, כדפירשנו:
Tosafot on Ketubot 16b:3:2.english: This indicates that one writes a receipt - Even though here [in this case] there is no other option — for there is [reason] to be concerned lest she burn her marriage contract before witnesses and then go back and collect with witnesses of the hinnuma, as [the Gemara] says shortly: "And perhaps she will go back and produce [evidence] through witnesses of the hinnuma and collect," according to the one who says [that] "one who pleads [payment] against an act of the court has said nothing," and therefore he needs a receipt — nevertheless, [Rabbi Abbahu] infers well that in general as well one writes a receipt; for if one does not write [a receipt] in general, why should he pay here, since he can come to a loss through the fact that the marriage contract is in her possession, as we explained [above].

Tosafot on Ketubot 16b:3:3.hebrew: כותבין שובר - אע"ג דבפרק גט פשוט (ב"ב קעא: ושם) מפרש טעמא דמאן דאמר כותבין שובר משום ד"עבד לוה לאיש מלוה" — לאו דוקא לוה, אלא הוא הדין בכל חוב, כמו כתובה דהכא ושטרי מקח דאמר התם דכותבין שובר:
Tosafot on Ketubot 16b:3:3.english: One writes a receipt - Even though in the chapter [entitled] Get Pashut (Bava Batra 171b and there) [the Gemara] explains [that] the reason of the one who says [that] one writes a receipt is because [Scripture states,] "The borrower is a slave to the lender" — [this does] not [apply] specifically [to] a borrower, rather the same law [applies] to any debt, such as a marriage contract [as in the case] here, and deeds of sale, regarding which [the Gemara] states there that one writes a receipt.

Tosafot on Ketubot 16b:6:1.hebrew: מאי איבדה איבדה באור - וא"ת, א"כ אפי' במקום שכותבין הוה ליה לאוקמי, ומאי דוחקא לאוקמי במקום שאין כותבין וכתב לה איהו? ואור"ת, דבמקום שכותבין ונשרפה איכא למיחש שכתב לה כתובה אחרת, דאסור להשהותה בלא כתובה. מיהו, הוה מצי לאוקומה במקום שכותבין ונשרפה אחר הגירושין, דליכא למיחש שמא כתב לה אחרת, אלא שנראה לו דוחק:
Tosafot on Ketubot 16b:6:1.english: What [is the meaning of] "she lost [it]"? She lost [it] in the fire - And if you ask: If so, he could have even established [the baraita] in a place where they write [a marriage contract], so why was he forced to establish it in a place where they do not write [one] and he [nevertheless] wrote [one] for her? And Rabbeinu Tam says that in a place where they write [a marriage contract] and it was burned, there is reason to be concerned that he wrote her another marriage contract, because it is forbidden to keep her [as his wife] without a marriage contract. However, he could have established it in a place where they write [a marriage contract] and it was burned after the divorce, where there is no reason to be concerned that he wrote her another [one], except that it seemed forced to him.

Tosafot on Ketubot 16b:7:1.hebrew: ותו איבדה למה לי - אף על גב דלכאורה היינו פירכא קמייתא, דפריך "היינו נשרפה", יש ליישב דהכי קאמר: ותו, אפילו אם נאמר ד"נשרפה" הוי פירושא ד"נאבדה", מכל מקום תקשי "איבדה למה לי":
Tosafot on Ketubot 16b:7:1.english: And furthermore, why do I [need] "she lost [it]" - Even though at first glance this is the first objection, where [the Gemara] asks, "That is 'it was burned,'" one can resolve [it by explaining] that this is what it is saying: "And furthermore," even if we say that "it was burned" is the explanation of "it was lost," nevertheless there is a difficulty: why do I [need] "she lost [it]"?
